verdicts.reason: After an Excel run is configured with its selected sheet, the ordinary source-upload caller at Workspace.tsx:280 supplies no options, so controller.ts:141 reuses this.workflow.source.worksheet and parseXlsx at xlsx.ts:56–58 bypasses discovery or rejects the replacement if that name is absent, contrary to excel-fidelity.md:70; incidence was not measured.

When a source and subsequent template share a sheet name, Workspace.tsx:38,318–324 retains the selected name after successful import and its template caller at :423–425 never clears it, enabling immediate import of the coincidentally named template sheet despite the independent-selection requirement at excel-fidelity.md:70; incidence was not measured.

For a second import that fails after worksheet selection, controller.ts:176–179 creates a distinct transition required by the plan's U9 failed-replacement scenario, but session.test.ts:178–192 exercises only discovery and cancellation and excel-input.spec.ts:199–208 explicitly exercises failures before any chooser, leaving that reachable failure transition and retained export unverified.
